sourceMethods: All 128 current subnet profiles checked. 100 dated September 9–10 channel briefs reviewed against the previous edition.

Signed-in X Latest searched all 128 subnet numbers and current names or aliases in 16 grouped queries. Public account samples and primary follow-ups covered projects, partners, emissions, StonkFun and community leads. Grok supplied additional leads that were checked against originals.
79 public X account candidates checked; 78 returned samples. 157 unique in-window post records retrieved; selected stories were followed to full original text.
Authenticated AlphaGap feed reviewed, including 18 current cards and 18 earlier-week cards. SubnetRadar, TAO Daily, TAO Media and the public subnet feed supplied further discovery leads.
156 repository paths scanned with pagination and refreshed through 11:07 AM ET. Selected changes, miner guides and current product pages were checked for activation conditions.

The latest 200 SubnetRadar Moments were reviewed, with 45 unique in-window linked events retained. Material coldkey, conviction and identity events were followed to their detail pages. Epago’s emission-disable arguments and successful execution were checked in the live explorer.
Market prices and emission shares captured at 11:07 AM ET and compared with the previous saved snapshot. Price badges are rolling 24-hour alpha/TAO changes.
YouTube Videos and Live tabs checked. The RL Bryer replay is 3,737 seconds and its broadcast has ended; September 8 remains the latest members upload.
accessGaps: X searches and account timelines were sampled, not exhaustively paginated. Grouped searches excluded replies and returned unrelated matches for ambiguous names. Private, deleted, unindexed and unsampled posts may be missing.

Private Discord history was not directly accessed. DSperse’s outage, RedTeam’s delays and NOVA’s Blueprint pause/refunds remain developing because their original discussions or completed recovery actions were not independently verified.

Five repository paths returned 404: deprecated/deprecated, actual-computer/actual-subnet-95, NIOME-BITTENSOR/NIOME, Oh-My-Ditto/ditto and Satori119/Satori. New identities and accessible replacement repositories were considered. Cross-linked Lium SDK work is attributed to SN51 rather than SN22.

Reported billing, retention, customer relationships and platform revenue have not been reconciled against private business records. Conjectures’ paper and stated proof scope were reviewed, but the formal verifier was not rerun.

The Epago disable transaction is confirmed. The signer’s real-world identity, decision rationale and any later reversal are not established. Zero or positive allocations elsewhere do not by themselves identify an administrative switch or verify miner payouts.

Grok and aggregator launch descriptions were corrected against primary sources: UMI’s “live” post linked an AMA; NIOME’s portal is still being finalized; Witness is a research preview; Cascade has future activation gates; Cortex and Reliquary retain explicit readiness limits.

Previously covered ORO YC acceptance, Chutes CEO news, Hippius pricing, original TAO pairs and the September 9 morning restoration were not republished as new launches. No new verified CONST/BUTT utility launch was established; community treasury proposals were not treated as shipped features.
Crucible’s September 9 iOS announcement is a labeled late-found item. Research cutoff: 11:07 AM ET on September 10. No independently verified forward unlock calendar was located.
